name: nordnet-mcp
description: Read-only MCP access to Nordnet brokerage accounts (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland) — accounts, positions, trades, balances, orders, and instrument lookup. Runs as a dockerized MCP server, so no Python/uv install is needed, only Docker.

nordnet_host.title: Nordnet market host
nordnet_host.description: Must match the market your Nordnet mobile app is registered in: public.nordnet.se (Sweden), public.nordnet.no (Norway), public.nordnet.dk (Denmark), or public.nordnet.fi (Finland).

nordnet_client_id.title: Nordnet client ID override (optional)
nordnet_client_id.description: Leave empty unless Nordnet responds with NEXT_INVALID_SESSION — then set this to NEXT and reinstall/restart the server.
